name: Vidosser
author: sweetyshots123
description: Collection of video viewing tools for WanGP. Currently: frame stepping with the mouse wheel (one notch = one frame, Shift = 10; by default only in fullscreen) and the keyboard (A/S = previous/next frame, Q/W = jump back/forward), and saving the exact displayed frame at full resolution (D or middle click, PNG/JPG, save-as dialog or direct to a folder). Works on the output gallery and every video player. Settings in the 'Vidosser' tab.
